claim.statement: The complete reasoning pipeline in Kimera-SWM is now mapped from code in a single 9-step chain: (1) perception → entropy_profile; (2) PRIOR cycle's entropy_profile → entropy_proxy (mean, clamped [0,1]); (3) entropy_proxy → α_swm → α_gamma = 2·α_swm − 0.5; (4) cronos.tick × 50 (dt=0.01s) drives Stuart-Landau oscillator; (5) 4 oscillator signals (leader_band, amplitude_death, hallucinating, annealing_active); (6) Walker enacts M1-M4 operators; (7) halt (amplitude_death | exhausted | selective); (8) THIS cycle's entropy_profile → feeds NEXT cycle's entropy_proxy; (9) loop closes. The pipeline is purely physical-dynamical; no symbolic decision layer.
claim.operationalization: Each pipeline step has a single file:line citation. Code locations: (2) takwin.py:7906-7911; (3) cognitive_rhythm.py:58, 568-578; (4) takwin.py:7920-7944, cognitive_rhythm.py:541; (5) cognitive_rhythm.py:101-114; (6) prime_topology_walker.py:512-660; (7) prime_topology_walker.py:521-530, 649-659.
